title: The Alibi of the Soothing Forest
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Kogoro Mouri, Ran, Conan) omitted by convention. No transcript lines are tagged (Flashback) in this episode -- the confession sequence is presented as present-tense narration recapping the same day's events, so all edges use temporal_frame: present. Culprit identity (Shiro Murakami) matches the old wiki-summary case file, but the old file's mechanism was thin: it only captured the clay/rope float trick and generic 'knows' edges. The transcript reveals the actual proof the detective uses is a seal (hanko) swap -- Shiro's and Ryuzo's personal stamps got switched during the struggle over scattered desk documents, and comparing stamp impressions across Aiko's milk-payment ledger (chipped vs. clean) against a liquor delivery order signed later at the boarding house is what places Shiro at the murder scene at 4:00pm -- captured here as clue c1, which the old file omitted entirely. The old file also omitted the policeman witness (Midorikawa Youji), the specific reason Aiko was cleared (no time to change/wash off blood), and the actual trigger for the murder (father Ryuzo mocking Shiro with 'you should have left home instead of Kinji' after already refusing him a loan). case_type: murder.

attrs.detail: runs beside both the village head's house and the boarding house; reachable from the house in 2-3 minutes by water despite no scaffold to tie a boat to

objects.name: Clay and rope from the boarding house entrance

attrs.trick: pants rinsed of blood, turned inside out and coated with clay, legs tied off with rope, then inflated as an improvised swimming float to travel downstream
attrs.staging_flaw: clay was visibly diminished and rope was missing from the entrance, tipping off the trick

attrs.detail: records a monthly stamped seal from Ryuzo at each milk-payment collection
stamped cleanly in the ledger every prior month; this month's impression is chipped
previously had a chipped stamp border; on a liquor delivery order signed at the boarding house on the day of the murder, the impression suddenly appears clean
retrieved by Shiro from Ryuzo's desk after the killing, to remove evidence of his visit and motive

clues.desc: Comparing seal impressions: Ryuzo's seal (o4) is stamped cleanly in Aiko's ledger (o3) every month but appears chipped this month; conversely, Shiro's own seal (o5), previously chipped, appears cleanly stamped on a liquor delivery order signed at the boarding house that same day. The two seals were swapped during the struggle over the scattered desk documents in Ryuzo's study, proving Shiro was physically at the crime scene around the time of the murder.

edges.detail: refuses to loan Shiro money and throws his watermelon gift back at him in front of the boarding-house guests
leaves the vegetable-gathering early, remembering something he had to do; returns alone to beg his father-in-law for a loan guarantee
collects the milk payment around 3:55pm and gets Ryuzo's seal stamped in her ledger
mocks Shiro for still lingering after being refused, telling him 'you should have left home instead of Kinji'

edges.method: stabbed with the victim's own paper knife in a sudden fit of rage

edges.detail: heard a scream at 4:00pm while walking toward the boarding house, turned back
on patrol, also heard the scream at 4:00pm
arrives at the scene just after 4:05pm
arrives back at the boarding house in time to answer Aiko's 4:10pm call
unknowingly stamps a liquor delivery order with Ryuzo's swapped seal
returns to the boarding house on foot around the same 4:10pm call, consistent with his stated alibi
